description:
Switch audio devices from the tray, with hotkeys, per-app routing and profiles.

Switchboard is a Windows tray app for every audio device you own. Click to switch the
default output or microphone, send one app to a different device, set per-app volume,
bind hotkeys, save profiles that apply when a game starts, connect Bluetooth speakers,
and see controller battery. It can also be controlled from your phone on the same network,
from the command line, or with switchboard:// links.
